# Asha Tensile Structures

> Asha Tensile Structures is an industry-leading manufacturer, designer, and turnkey contractor specializing in premium architectural tensile fabric structures, membrane canopies, car parking shades, walkway coverings, gazebos, sports coverings, and luxury resort tents across India.

Important notes:
- Official website: https://www.ashatensilestructures.in/
- Headquarters: Asha Industries, Akashvani, 1734 Chitrakut Hos. Soc. B/H, Makarpura Rd, Vadodara, Gujarat 390010, India
- Phone: +91 957 472 0006
- Email: info@ashatensilestructures.com
- Geo Coordinates: 22.259113812029724, 73.19655814478237
- Primary Materials: PVC-coated fabric membranes, ETFE architectural foils, hybrid HDPE shade cloth
- Service Areas: Turnkey design, structural engineering, precision fabrication, site installation, and maintenance across all Indian states and international exports.
- Content Policy: Public technical documentation, product catalogs, architectural guidelines, and customer inquiries.

## Architectural Membrane & Material Guides
- [Architectural Membrane Introduction](https://www.ashatensilestructures.in/architecturalMembraneIntroduction.html): Technical introduction to membrane mechanics, structural tensile principles, and durability standards.
- [PVC Coated Fabric Solutions](https://www.ashatensilestructures.in/PVC_Coated_Fabric.html): High-tensile PVC architectural membranes with PVDF protective lacquers for UV and fire resistance.
- [ETFE Foil Membranes](https://www.ashatensilestructures.in/ETFE_FOIL.html): Lightweight pneumatic and single-skin fluoropolymer ETFE foil installations with 95% light transmission.
- [HDPE Shade Fabric](https://www.ashatensilestructures.in/HDPE_Fabric.html): Monofilament and tape yarn hybrid knitted shade cloths providing up to 98% UV blockage and cooling benefits.
- [Resort Glamping Tents](https://www.ashatensilestructures.in/resortTent.html): Luxury weatherproof tensile tents for eco-resorts, hospitality retreats, and outdoor living.

## Primary Tensile Structure Categories
- Car Parking Canopies: Single pole, double pole, two-way cantilever, and multi-bay tensile car parking sheds.
- Sports & Stadium Covers: Badminton court roofs, tennis court shade sails, swimming pool canopies, and stadium spectator covers.
- Commercial & Hospitality: Banquet hall roofs, cafeteria canopies, atrium skylights, entrance canopies, and security cabins.
- Industrial & Infrastructure: Toll plaza canopies, warehouse tensile roofing, basement ramps, and modular office enclosures.
